exposure: Colour coding classification system for emergency operations
cohort: Patients undergoing non-caesarean section emergency operations at Sarawak General Hospital.
finding: The implementation of a colour coding classification system significantly reduced the mean Time-to-theatre (TTT) for emergency operation patients from 13 hours 48 minutes to 10 hours.
mod_finding: Caesarean cases were excluded from the colour coding classification system, meaning the intervention's effectiveness was specifically for non-caesarean section emergency cases.
